ui.intro_subtitle: Take a photo of your bill. We explain it in simple words and tell you if anything looks wrong.
ui.intro_step_scan: Take a photo of your bill
ui.intro_step_listen: Read or listen to a simple explanation
ui.intro_step_check: Know if your bill looks normal
ui.privacy: Your bill photo is sent to Google's Gemini AI to read it. We keep no copy online, and your saved bills stay on this phone. Google may use photos sent to its free AI to improve it. For full privacy, use your reference number instead.
ui.unofficial: Bill Samjho is not an official app of WAPDA, K-Electric or any electricity company. It only gives advice.
ui.step_photo: Take a clear photo of your bill
ui.step_listen: Read or listen to what it means
ui.credit_bill: This is a credit bill: you have nothing to pay this month.
ui.demo_banner: Demo mode: showing a sample bill, not your real bill.
ui.pick_title: Which meter is this bill for?
ui.take_photo: Take a photo of your bill
ui.take_photo_body: Put the bill on a flat surface in good light. Make sure the whole bill is in the photo.
ui.reading_hint: This usually takes less than 10 seconds.
ui.confirm_hint: Compare with your paper bill. If a number is wrong, correct it.
ui.confirm_low_confidence: The photo was not fully clear. Please check the numbers carefully.
ui.lookup_intro: Enter the 14-digit reference number printed on your bill. We open your bill on the official PITC website for your company.
ui.reference_invalid: Enter all 14 digits of your reference number.
ui.kelectric_note: K-Electric (Karachi) bills are not on this website. Take a photo of your paper bill instead.
ui.lookup_privacy: Your reference number goes only to the official PITC website, not to us.
ui.lookup_tap_search: This is the official PITC website. Tap "Search" to open your bill.
ui.lookup_bill_open: Your bill is open. Pinch to zoom, then tap "Explain this bill".
ui.lookup_waiting: Open your bill above, then tap here.
ui.lookup_failed: We could not read this bill page. Take a photo of your paper bill instead.
ui.page_error: The PITC website could not be opened. Check your internet and try again.
ui.get_latest_hint: Opens this meter's bill on the PITC website.
ui.complain_body: We will write a complaint message for you. Send it or call 118.
ui.advice_only: This is advice only. Always compare with your paper bill.
ui.tts_tip: To hear explanations, install Google Speech Services.
ui.forecast_disclaimer: Rough estimate. Fuel adjustments, taxes and rate changes can change the real bill.
ui.forecast_intro: Type the number on your electricity meter today and we'll estimate next month's units and bill.
ui.forecast_reading_note: Read the digits on your meter from left to right. Leave out any red digit or decimal.
ui.forecast_enter_number: Enter the number shown on your meter.
ui.forecast_too_soon: This bill's reading was taken today. Try again in a day or two.
ui.forecast_too_old: This bill is more than 2 months old. Add your latest bill first.
ui.forecast_no_date: This bill shows no reading or due date, so we can't count the days.
ui.forecast_too_big: That is much more than a normal home uses. Please check the number.
ui.chat_entry_title: Have a question about this bill?
ui.chat_entry_body: Ask in your own words. We explain simply.
ui.chat_welcome: Assalam-o-Alaikum! Ask me anything about your {month} bill.
ui.chat_error: I couldn't answer right now. Please try again.
ui.chat_unavailable: The helper is not available right now. Please try again later.
ui.chat_disclaimer: Answers come from AI and can be wrong. Always check your paper bill.
ui.chat_limit: You have asked many questions in this chat. Please open a new chat later.
ui.chat_privacy: Your question and this bill's numbers are sent to Google's Gemini AI to answer.
ui.dictate_permission: To speak your question, allow the microphone for Bill Samjho in your phone settings.
ui.dictate_unavailable: Voice typing is not available on this phone. Please type your question.
ui.dictate_noSpeech: I didn't hear anything. Tap the mic and speak again.
ui.dictate_network: Voice typing needs the internet. Check your connection and try again.
ui.dictate_language: Voice typing in English is not available on this phone. Please type your question.
ui.dictate_other: Voice typing stopped. Please try again.
ui.chat_voice_privacy: If you speak, your phone's speech service turns your voice into text.
ui.chat_q1: Why is my bill this amount?
ui.chat_q3: How can I lower my bill?
ui.chat_q4: When do I get the cheaper rate?
ui.voice_failed: Couldn't play the voice on this phone. Install or update Google Speech Services.
ui.complaint_hint: You can edit this message before sending it.
ui.complaint_escalate: If your company does not fix it, you can complain to NEPRA on nepra.org.pk or in the NEPRA Asaan Approach app.
ui.delete_meter_q: Delete this meter and all its bills?
ui.long_press_hint: Press and hold a bill to delete it.
ui.data_on_device: Your bills are saved only on this phone, encrypted. No account, no phone number, no CNIC.
ui.clear_all_q: Delete all meters and bills? This cannot be undone.

glossary.title: Fuel Price Adjustment
glossary.meaning: A monthly charge when the price of fuel used to make electricity changes. It applies to everyone in the country, and is sometimes negative.

glossary.title: Quarterly Adjustment
glossary.meaning: Every three months the government raises or lowers electricity rates. That change appears on this line.

glossary.title: General Sales Tax
glossary.meaning: Federal government tax on the cost of electricity.

glossary.title: Electricity Duty
glossary.meaning: A provincial tax. It was removed from electricity bills from July 2025, so newer bills should not have it.

glossary.title: Fixed Charges
glossary.meaning: Since February 2026, a monthly charge for each kilowatt (kW) of your sanctioned load, even if you use little electricity. Lifeline homes do not pay it.

glossary.title: Arrears
glossary.meaning: Unpaid amount from earlier bills. If you already paid, show your receipt to get it removed.

glossary.title: Late Payment Surcharge
glossary.meaning: A penalty added if you pay after the due date. Pay on time to avoid it.

glossary.title: TV Fee
glossary.meaning: The Rs 35 PTV fee was removed from electricity bills in July 2025. If a new bill still shows it, ask your electricity company.
